input.behavior_to_protect: A metadata header row with an empty cell in one column must be preserved: write_rst_table pads it to the column width and read_rst_table recovers the empty string.

description: Write one regression scenario where a metadata header row has an empty cell in one column; write_rst_table must pad it to the column width and read_rst_table must recover the empty string, not skip the column. The scenario must fail a mutant that truncates empty metadata cells.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
